G2-02.ko: 이끼 뭉치가 철퍼덕 · 푹 터지고 다시 돋음
G2-02.atk: a small clump of damp moss flings itself forward: a light wet squelch, a puff of spores, then a soft leafy slap against the target
G2-02.def: no real block, the spongy body bursts: a muffled wet pop, moss crumbs pattering down, then a faint rustle of tiny green shoots sprouting back

G2-03.ko: 서툰 활시위 튕김 · 놀라 휘청이며 잔가지 밟음
G2-03.atk: a thin green bow creaks and a clumsy string twangs, a short arrow whistles through low leaves, then lands with a small light thock
G2-03.def: no armour, it flinches: a startled troll huff, a quiver rattling on its back, a stumble that snaps a dry twig underfoot

G2-04.ko: 덩굴이 채찍처럼 휘감김 · 덩굴이 조여 되받아침
G2-04.atk: drowsy vines unwind with a dry rustle, then whip out in a sharp green lash that cracks across the target with a wet snap
G2-04.def: glancing hit on a body wrapped in tendrils: vines tighten with a squeaky creak, then a bramble whip flicks back with a small barbed snap

G2-05.ko: 어린 가지 팔로 톡 · 줄기가 텅 울리고 뿌리 꿈틀
G2-05.atk: a sapling-thin branch arm swings with a soft creak and a light whoosh, ending in a springy wooden thwack
G2-05.def: partial block with a slender trunk: a hollow wooden tock, roots shuffling nervously in loose soil, young leaves quivering

G2-08.ko: 삽 지팡이로 흙 내리침 · 이끼 어깨로 받고 꽃잎
G2-08.atk: a gravedigger's gnarled digging staff swings low with a heavy whoosh, bites into earth with a dull thump, and scatters a soft patter of petals
G2-08.def: takes the blow on a thick mossy shoulder: a damp muffled thud, a deep gentle troll grumble, then flower petals drifting down

G2-09.ko: 껍질 방패로 들이받음 · 방패가 쪼개지고 새 껍질이 삐걱
G2-09.atk: a slab of stripped bark is shouldered forward with a rough scrape, then slams in a flat dry crack, shedding brittle flakes
G2-09.def: the bark shield is too thin and splits: a splintering crack, curling shards clattering, a stagger, then a faint creak of fresh bark growing over the break

G2-11.ko: 출렁다리 위 창 끝 찌름 · 육중한 몸으로 둔탁하게 받음
G2-11.atk: on a swaying rope bridge, a short spear jabs out: planks creak, a taut rope hums, then a crisp sharp tap of the spearhead
G2-11.def: no shield, a big troll body soaks the blow: a dull meaty thump, the plank bridge swaying and groaning, a deep huff of breath

G2-13.ko: 속 빈 고목에서 화살 일제히 · 줄기가 텅 울림
G2-13.atk: from inside a hollow trunk, a ragged volley of bowstring twangs, arrows whistling through leaves, then a scatter of quick thocks as they land
G2-13.def: the hollow trunk takes the hit: branches shake, dry wood splinters, a deep hollow boom rolls inside, and dead leaves rain down

G2-15.ko: 무리가 발 구르며 주먹 · 어깨 맞대고 부딪힘
G2-15.atk: a pack of trolls stamps forward, heavy feet pounding earth, then their fists swing in a clattering double thud against the target
G2-15.def: shoulder to shoulder, they absorb the blow: grunting huffs, coarse hide slapping hide, soft thuds into moss, boots shuffling and bracing

G2-17.ko: 씹던 이끼를 뱉어 포자탄 · 포자 구름으로 푹신하게 막음
G2-17.atk: a wet chewing of moss, a gloopy spit, then a green spore bolt flies with a hissing whoosh and bursts in a damp muffled puff
G2-17.def: a thick cloud of spores billows up as a cushion: a spongy muffled thud, a low gurgling grumble, fine dust settling softly

G2-20.ko: 계단에서 일제히 창 찌름 · 옻칠한 나무판이 철컥
G2-20.atk: boots stamp in unison on wooden stairs, a polished spear shaft slides, then thrusts forward with a crisp precise crack
G2-20.def: lacquered wooden plates clack together in formation, the hit lands on a stout shoulder with a firm thump, and stair boards creak under braced feet

G2-21.ko: 고목 팔을 들어 내리찍음 · 줄기가 깊게 울리며 갈라짐
G2-21.atk: a slow, angry timber groan as an oak arm winds back, a thunderous overhead slam, then bark shards and acorns pattering down
G2-21.def: no armour but a huge trunk: a deep resonant boom through the whole body, a splintering crack along the bark, a long grieved groan

G2-22.ko: 가시덤불 길에서 팔로 긁음 · 가시 잔뜩 터뜨려 찌름
G2-22.atk: a thorn-studded arm sweeps through brittle thicket with snapping twigs, then rakes across the target in a long tearing scrape
G2-22.def: a quick crackle of needle-like clicks as spines burst outward from its hide, snagging the attacker with tiny sharp ticking stabs

G2-23.ko: 낙엽 소용돌이가 돌며 수액 파동 · 잎 장막이 스르륵
G2-23.atk: a swirling gust of leaves spirals up around a living-wood staff, then releases a deep pressure whump of green sap energy
G2-23.def: a curtain of leaves rustles up around the robe, dew drops shimmer glassily, and the blow dissolves into a soft muffled thud

G2-25.ko: 발밑 뿌리가 땅을 찢고 솟음 · 뿌리 벽이 일어나 막음
G2-25.atk: a staff strikes the ground and roots burst up with a ripping tear of earth, lash through the air, and clamp around the foe with a heavy wooden crunch
G2-25.def: thick roots rise in a wall from the soil: loose dirt trickling, deep grinding creaks, the blow landing with a solid dense thud on knotted wood

G2-26.ko: 굵은 가지로 쓸어치고 도토리가 우수수 · 속 깊은 줄기 울림
G2-26.atk: an immense limb sweeps in with a long ancient creak and a heavy rushing whoosh, crashes down, and sprinkles a rattle of acorns and bark
G2-26.def: a deep bell-like boom resonates through the old trunk, a long settling groan follows, and a shower of leaves drifts to the ground

G2-27.ko: 이끼 바위 몸이 몸을 떨며 마력 · 바위처럼 푹신히 흡수
G2-27.atk: a moss-caked body shudders with a low grinding of stone, spores pulse out, then a green magic burst thumps forward with a soft swelling whump
G2-27.def: the mossy hide behaves like a boulder wrapped in sponge: a muffled solid thud, a puff of spores, and a very low reverent grumble

G2-28.ko: 뿌리 내린 채 어깨로 밀침 · 도끼날이 둔탁하게 튕김
G2-28.atk: rooted in place, it leans a single immense shoulder forward: earth grinds and heaves, wood groans, and a slow trunk shove booms outward
G2-28.def: an immovable trunk, roots creaking tighter into soil: an axe blade bites with a dull chunk and bounces off, bark chips falling

G2-30.ko: 오래된 장궁 낮게 울림 · 문짝 같은 몸으로 묵직히 받음
G2-30.atk: an ancient longbow's unworn string gives a slow deep thrum, a heavy arrow whooshes, then punches home with a weighty crack
G2-30.def: a dense gate-like body takes the hit: old ironwood hinges creak, a heavy dull thump, and a long low exhale

G2-31.ko: 꽃잎 바람이 휘감겨 쓸어침 · 맞으면 꽃이 피어남
G2-31.atk: a warm gust carries a sweep of petals, soft blossoms pop open along the arm, and the body lands a surprisingly heavy thud
G2-31.def: each blow bursts into flowers: petals flutter outward, a soft heavy thud, then a gentle creak of stems knitting and blooming again

G2-32.ko: 아주 느린 거대 내리침 · 동굴처럼 깊은 줄기 울림
G2-32.atk: a vast, very slow groan from deep in the trunk, a colossal limb falling with a ground-shaking slam, and a long rolling rumble after
G2-32.def: a cavernous boom swallows the hit, enormous wood creaks as it settles, and a drizzle of bark dust and leaves falls in the stillness

G2-33.ko: 가지 채찍질 · 되감기는 듯한 잎사귀 소리로 회복
G2-33.atk: a standing branch lashes out with a sharp crackle of snapping twigs and a whipping swish, trailing a faint shimmer of strangely reversed rustling leaves
G2-33.def: a glancing knock on a hard limb, then a backwards-sounding rustle as shoots regrow and twigs crackle into place

G2-34.ko: 잎 돋은 창끝으로 돌진 · 나무 갑옷 조각이 딸각
G2-34.atk: a carved wooden lance thrusts with a long whoosh and a hard thock, then fresh leaves unfurl at its tip with a delicate fluttering rustle
G2-34.def: no solid guard, wooden armour plates clatter and knock against each other, the knight staggers with a creak of saddle-like leather

G2-35.ko: 고목들이 느리게 삐걱이다 마력 · 거대한 합쳐진 울림
G2-35.atk: many old trunks creak in a slow overlapping swell, branches rubbing, then a deep sap-heavy magic pulse rolls outward
G2-35.def: a ring of ancient trunks closes ranks with grinding timber, the hit vanishes into a massive hollow thud, and a patient groan answers

G2-36.ko: 거대한 심장 박동이 충격파 · 나무 살 속에서 쿵
G2-36.atk: a giant wooden heartbeat thuds, roots tremble underground, then a pulse of shockwave erupts with a deep boom and a rattle of loose soil
G2-36.def: the blow is swallowed by a deep slow heartbeat under thick bark, a muffled double thump, then sap gurgling as wood knits back

G2-41.ko: 가지를 꺾어 창 던짐 · 땅에 박혀 뿌리 내림
G2-41.atk: a branch snaps over a knee with a dry crack, the spear is hurled with a hard whoosh, and it pierces through with a sharp thunk
G2-41.def: thin and unarmoured, it dodges: a sudden leap, a leafy scramble, the blow brushing past with a whiff and a small startled grunt

G2-42.ko: 말벌 떼가 웅 하고 쏘아 꿰뚫음 · 흩어졌다 다시 뭉침
G2-42.atk: a rising angry buzz, a rapid dive of countless wings, then a pattering of sharp stings that pierce through with tiny hard ticks
G2-42.def: the swarm bursts apart in a scattering buzz, a few thin pops of crushed insects, then the wings regroup into a tight whirring hum

G2-43.ko: 탄 나무가 돌진해 박살 · 숯 부스러지고 불씨 튐
G2-43.atk: a charred half-trunk charges with crackling charcoal and a smoldering hiss, then rams through with a splitting crash
G2-43.def: the burnt half crumbles: charcoal falling in brittle chunks, ember ticks hissing, and a sullen groan from the living half

SP-G2.ko: 은빛 파동과 가시 휘두름 · 달빛 가호 위에 가시 폭발
SP-G2.atk: a silvery rising shimmer, a thorn-laced arm sweeps with a hard burning-wood crack, and a glassy lunar ring blooms over the impact
SP-G2.def: a shimmering ward flares like cold moonlight, bark spines burst outward in a crackling spray, and licks of ember hiss out under sap

UN-G2.en: Thorn Keeper of the First Tree
UN-G2.ko: 가시덤불 벽이 닫히며 조임 · 베어도 뿌리가 다시 이어짐
UN-G2.atk: a hedge of brambles closes in with a dry rattle, tangling and crushing together with a tight thorny creak and a rending snap
UN-G2.def: the cut vines fall with a snip, then roots re-knit underground with wet creaking and a slow knotting of wood, thorns springing back

UN-G2-7.ko: 씨앗 주머니 휘둘러 흩뿌림 · 싹이 터 올라 막음
UN-G2-7.atk: a pouch of seeds swings with a dry rattle, a spray of seeds hisses through the air, then they thud into the foe and pop with tiny green sprouts
UN-G2-7.def: the old troll's body sags under the hit with a soft grunt, the seed pouch rattles, and sprouts burst up around him in a creaking green shield

EP-G2-1.ko: 녹슨 가시가 쇠처럼 긁힘 · 가호 위에 쇠가시 분출
EP-G2-1.atk: rust-hardened thorns scrape with a metallic screech, a heavy branch swings, and the spikes ring against the target with a harsh iron clang
EP-G2-1.def: a shimmering ward blooms, and then iron-hard needles spray out with a ringing metallic crackle, rust flakes pattering after

EP-G2-2.ko: 높은 가지에서 길게 당겨 쏨 · 잎 사이로 몸을 피함
EP-G2-2.atk: a long bow draw creaks high in the canopy, the string gives a deep thrum, an arrow whistles a long way, and lands far below with a small clean thock
EP-G2-2.def: no armour, it leaps along the branch: a leafy rustle, the arrow missing with a whiff, and foliage closing back over its position

EP-G2-3.ko: 고목 거인이 땅을 내리밟음 · 가호 위에 가시 폭발
EP-G2-3.atk: a giant plants a foot with an earth-cracking stomp, swings a branch-laden fist with a deep roar of wind, and smashes with a thundering crunch
EP-G2-3.def: a shimmering ward ripples across the bark, the impact lands on solid wood with a heavy boom, and long spines burst out with a snarling crackle

PN-G2-C1.ko: 잔가지 톡 · 잘려도 낭창 튕기며 새순 돋음
PN-G2-C1.atk: a tiny twig flicks out with a light whip and a small tick, brushing the target with a faint leafy tap
PN-G2-C1.def: cut stems snip with a soft crisp sound, the stalk bounces springily, and a squeaky creak shows it growing right back to height

PN-G2-C2.ko: 뿌리로 땅을 움켜쥐고 휘두름 · 뿌리가 깊어지며 찔레 되받음
PN-G2-C2.atk: roots hook the ground and drag with a ripping tear, then a bramble-laden arm sweeps across with a rasping whoosh
PN-G2-C2.def: roots grind deeper into dirt with a stubborn creak, the hit lands on knotted wood, and a briar rake scrapes back at the attacker

PN-G2-C3.ko: 물 먹은 고목이 느릿 철썩 · 녹물이 뚝뚝 흘러내림
PN-G2-C3.atk: a waterlogged limb creaks sluggishly, drags through mud with a thick squelch, and slaps down with a heavy wet smack
PN-G2-C3.def: the swollen trunk takes a damp dull thud, rusty swamp water drips and trickles, and small bubbles blurp out of the bark

PN-G2-U1.ko: 덩굴이 늘어난 활시위 · 덩굴이 상처를 묶어 조임
PN-G2-U1.atk: a vine-wrapped bow stretches with a rubbery creak, the string snaps with a sharp twang, and a swift arrow hits with a quick tick
PN-G2-U1.def: vines tighten over a wound with a squeaking rope-like creak, a muffled thud, and a gentle rustle as the tendrils tie off

PN-G2-U2.ko: 뿌리째 박힌 채 쿵 내리침 · 뿌리로 고정, 쐐기풀 찔림
PN-G2-U2.atk: a thorned root-staff is raised from the earth with a tearing of soil, then smacks down with a hard flat crack
PN-G2-U2.def: feet locked into roots with a grinding grip, it does not budge: a solid thud, a deep creak, and a nettle sting that prickles back

PN-G2-R.ko: 젖은 이끼 주먹이 철퍼덕 · 이끼 속 가시가 찌름
PN-G2-R.atk: a huge fist of soaked moss swings with a wet whoosh and lands with a heavy squelching splat that drips and sprays
PN-G2-R.def: thick moss cushions the blow in a spongy muffled thud, then hidden spines poke through with tiny dry pricks and a rustle of memory-laden leaves

PN-G2-E.ko: 몸에 자란 숲이 우르르 휘두름 · 가호 위 가시 터짐
PN-G2-E.atk: a body overgrown with a whole forest lurches forward, small trees creaking, ferns whispering, then one massive moss-heavy fist crashes down
PN-G2-E.def: a ward shimmers over living bark, the blow sinks into deep moss and wood with a hushed thud, and thorns burst outward like a rattle of snapping branches

UP-G2-17.ko: 이끼 바닥이 일어서 덮침 · 두꺼운 이끼 층이 겹겹이 막음
UP-G2-17.atk: a carpet of moss swells up and rolls forward with a thick sucking squelch, then breaks over the target in a heavy smothering rustle
UP-G2-17.def: layers of moss pile up around him one after another with soft wet slaps, the blow dying in a very deep muffled thump and a pleased low grumble

UP-G2-22.ko: 가시 문짝이 쾅 닫힘 · 문 같은 가시벽이 막고 찌름
UP-G2-22.atk: a huge gate of woven thorns swings shut with a groaning creak and a crashing slam, then ground-shaking vibrations roll underfoot
UP-G2-22.def: a thorn gate bars the way: the impact booms against thick woven wood, then long briar spikes lash out with a rasping whipcrack

UP-G2-23.ko: 세 갈래 잎 회오리가 하나로 · 겹겹 잎 장막과 수액 파동
UP-G2-23.atk: three streams of leaves whirl into a single roaring spiral, then a sap-heavy green blast slams outward with a deep concussive boom
UP-G2-23.def: layered veils of leaves rustle up in sequence, dew droplets shimmer, and the strike dissolves into a deep soft swell of sap

SG2-01.cast: vines burst out of the soil with a tearing rustle, lash through the air with a sharp whipcrack, and coil around a weapon hand with a tightening squeak

SG2-02.cast: an old trunk peels a slab of bark with a long dry tearing creak, the slab clacks onto a warrior's chest, and the edges knit into place with a soft wooden settling

SG2-03.cast: thorny brambles sprout in the dark with quick crackling pops, tangling taller and denser into a rattling hedge, ending with a dry settling of spines

MG-08.cast: roots rip upward from deep earth with a muffled tearing rumble, snake around ankles with rough scraping creaks, and cinch tight with a gripping wooden squeak

SG2-04.cast: roots pull free from soil with sucking tearing pops, heavy trunks groan to a stand, and slow thunderous footsteps rumble onward while branches creak and swell

SG2-05.cast: thick amber sap drips and oozes with a warm viscous glug, brushes across wounds with a soft smear, and wood knits closed with a gentle creaking rustle

MC-11.ko: 숲이 숨을 멈추고 소리가 눌려 꺼짐
MC-11.cast: the forest's rustling suddenly sinks into a hush: leaves still, a dull muffled pressure squeezes, swords fall silent with a faint dull clunk, and a deep sinking drain follows

MG-10.cast: ancient branches sag and sweep down with a long heavy rustle, interlace into a drooping curtain of leaves, and tiny thorns tick as they set

SG2-07.cast: thistle stalks burst up with fast crisp snaps and grow into tall rustling walls, stiff spiky heads clacking together as the fortress stiffens and settles

MC-14.ko: 수많은 덩굴이 적진을 덮쳐 칭칭 감김
MC-14.cast: a rush of countless vines crashes across the ground with a sweeping rustle, snapping taut around feet and weapons with creaking squeaks, a heavy green smothering thud closing it

MG-14.ko: 이끼 용의 시선이 내려와 포근히 감쌈
MG-14.cast: a deep distant dragon-like rumble passes over the forest, a warm shimmer of dew falls on moss, and mossy scales rustle gently around allies

SG2-08.cast: a whole forest surges forward: branches whooshing, roots drumming hard on ground, leaf-swept gusts rising in a rushing, swelling crash of foliage

SG2-09.cast: a fallen branch thumps into soil, sends up a fast creaking trunk with a swelling groan, and thorny boughs spread with a crackling rustle overhead

RG2-1.ko: 숲이 숨을 죽이고 가시만 천천히 자람
RG2-1.cast: all ambient sound is sucked away with a low swelling hush, blades and wings stall with faint clinks, then thorns grow slowly with creeping dry ticks

NG2-1.cast: many bowstrings snap overhead at once, a hissing whistle of arrows falls through leaves, and two hard volleys patter and thunk into the ground

NG2-3.cast: a severed limb creaks as green shoots push out with wet tender cracks, wood knits together with a warm rustling squeak, and a deep resolute grumble answers

US-G2-1.ko: 베인 가지가 붙고 자리마다 가시가 돋음
US-G2-1.cast: a warm wind rustles across the grove, split branches creak and rejoin with wooden clicks, and a prickling crackle of new thorns bursts across every bark surface

US-G2-2.ko: 천 년 고목이 뿌리째 걸어 나옴
US-G2-2.cast: a thousand-year trunk groans awake, roots rip free from earth with a deep tearing roar, and a shuddering step shakes the ground with a rolling boom

PS-G2-1.cast: a slow concentric tightening of wood: layer upon layer creaks and swells around the trunk, each ring closing with a firm low knock and a settling groan

PS-G2-2.ko: 발이 땅에 묻혀 나무가 되어 버팀
PS-G2-2.cast: boots sink into soil with a squelch, toes split into roots that grind downward, and the body stiffens into bark with a long dry creak

RS-G2-1.ko: 뿌리가 적 뒤에서 솟아 수액을 빨아올림
RS-G2-1.cast: roots crawl underground with a muffled scraping rumble, burst up behind the foe with a ripping thump, then sap pulls upward with a gulping slurp

RS-G2-2.ko: 숲길이 덤불로 닫혀 벤 만큼 찔림
RS-G2-2.cast: a woodland path swallows itself in a rapid snapping growth, brambles knit together with a rough scraping rustle, and briars rake back as a blade chops into them

RS-G2-3.ko: 이끼가 쓰러지지 못하게 덮고 포자가 숨 막음
RS-G2-3.cast: damp moss spreads in a soft wet crawl across bodies, bracing them with a spongy swelling, then a cloud of spores puffs out and a choking hiss rolls over the foe

CS-G2.ko: 이끼가 주문을 덮어 꺼뜨리고 상처를 아물림
CS-G2.cast: thick moss slaps over a crackling spell with a smothering wet squelch, the sparks fizzle out into a damp hiss, and underneath wounds knit with a soft creak

IG2-1.equip: a thorny pattern sprouts across skin with tiny scratchy pricks, a faint scrape of a needle-like carving, and in use a quick prickling tick when struck

IG2-2.equip: a rough bark pattern is pressed onto the arm with a dry scraping crunch, spreading and hardening with a soft layered creak, tapping hollow like wood afterwards

IG2-3.equip: braided moss is looped over the neck with a soft damp rustle, its tiny knots cinch with a squeak, and it pulses with a faint shimmering hush

I3-3.ko: 긴 활에 시위를 걸고 한 번 당겨 봄
I3-3.equip: a tall bow of pale wood is strung with a tense creak, the string plucks a deep test thrum, and a well-oiled limb flexes with a smooth wooden sigh

IG2-4.equip: thistle stalks woven into a cuirass are cinched over the chest with a dry squeaking rustle, spiky heads clicking together, and a prickly crackle when it settles

IG2-5.ko: 씨앗을 심장 옆에 심자 숨결이 퍼짐
IG2-5.equip: a small seed is pressed against the ribs with a soft thump, a damp earthy crackle of a root taking hold, and a slow warm throb of new growth

IG2-6.ko: 용의 뿌리가 혈관을 따라 뻗어 듦
IG2-6.equip: a long pale root creeps along an arm with a slow stretching creak, tiny rootlets pop through skin with a wet crackle, and a deep faint rumble hums within

M4-1.ko: 천 년 나이테가 몸에 한 겹씩 새겨짐
M4-1.equip: concentric ring grooves are carved into the chest with slow gouging scrapes, each ring knocks hollow and thick, and a deep ancient creak settles into the body

IR-G2.ko: 첫 고목이 스스로 떨군 껍질을 두름
IR-G2.equip: a huge old slab of bark drops from a trunk with a splitting thud, wraps around the shoulders with a rough heavy scrape, and blade-sized thorns tick outward

PI-G2.equip: a glowing first seed is pushed into the chest with a soft glassy shimmer, a trunk-deep creak spreads outward, and thorns and leaves swell into a living ward

TK-G2-1.atk: a short curtain of vines whips forward with a rustling lash, tapping the target with a light wet slap before it droops
TK-G2-1.def: no armour but a thick green lattice: vines absorb the blow with squeaky stretching, thump softly, then wither with a dry crisp rattle

TK-U-ROOT.ko: 뿌리가 땅에서 쑥 뻗어 툭 침 · 베여도 꿈틀
TK-U-ROOT.atk: a root rises from the soil with a muffled tearing sound and jabs forward with a stubby woody thud and a dirty patter of soil
TK-U-ROOT.def: cut roots snap with a damp crack, bits writhe and squirm in the dirt, then a slow soft creak shows them creeping back

TK-U-SAPLING.ko: 작은 묘목이 가냘프게 휘며 톡 · 흙에 박혀 섬
TK-U-SAPLING.atk: a green sapling bends and snaps forward with a light springy swish, a gentle leafy tap on the target, a few leaves fluttering
TK-U-SAPLING.def: the thin stem bends flat under the hit with a squeaky creak, soil shifts around its base, and it springs back up with a soft rustle

TK-U-TREE.ko: 자란 고목이 가지로 쿵 · 줄기로 단단히 받음
TK-U-TREE.atk: a grown young trunk swings a thick low branch with a firm creak and a solid wooden whump, ending in a rattle of falling leaves
TK-U-TREE.def: a sturdy young trunk takes the blow with a dense knock, bark shifts with a short grinding creak, and resin gurgles faintly in the grain
